==Enemies==
'''Actor''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Actor1 (Lunar Overture)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 1 in [[The Great Finale]]
*[[Actor1 (Nil Zone)]], a fast enemy that first appears on Wave 13 in [[Nil Zone]] and can be summoned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)]] and [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)]], appears in [[The Narratorium]] via the [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]
*[[Actor2 (Lunar Overture)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 in [[The Great Finale]]
*[[Actor2 (Nil Zone)]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 13 in [[Nil Zone]] and can be summoned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)]], [[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)]] and [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)]], appears in [[The Narratorium]] via the [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]
*[[Actor3 (Lunar Overture)]], a high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 12 in [[The Great Finale]]
*[[Actor3 (Nil Zone)]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 13 in [[Nil Zone]] and can be summoned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)]] and [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)]], appears in [[The Narratorium]] via the [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]
